content: Next.js useSearchParams (docs lastUpdated 2026-07-14): client-only hook; on prerendered/static routes the client tree up to nearest <Suspense> is client-rendered; production build FAILS with missing-suspense-with-csr-bailout unless the component using it is wrapped in Suspense (dev mode hides this). Update params via router.push/replace(pathname + '?' + params) or Link; window.history.replaceState also works for shallow updates.
